entries.claim_text: The governor of Qeshm blamed a 'terrorist enemy' for the ship attack and said authorities had not yet identified the projectile; the U.S. military had not commented.

entries.story_title: Attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz
entries.claim_text: The UK Maritime Trade Operations centre said a second vessel was hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz late Saturday; a fire broke out and local authorities were evacuating the crew.

entries.story_title: Houthi west-coast offensive / govt counter-offensive around Mokha
entries.claim_text: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed a large-scale missile-and-drone strike on a Saudi military base in Sharurah in southern Saudi Arabia, targeting weapons depots and command-and-control centers.

entries.story_title: Houthi west-coast offensive / govt counter-offensive around Mokha
entries.claim_text: The Houthis said the Sharurah strike answered a wave of Saudi airstrikes they put at 129 sorties over 48 hours, a count Saudi Arabia had not confirmed.

entries.story_title: Houthi west-coast offensive / govt counter-offensive around Mokha
entries.claim_text: Saudi Civil Defence said a Houthi projectile injured two people in the Jazan region and damaged several buildings, including a mosque.

entries.story_title: Houthi west-coast offensive / govt counter-offensive around Mokha
entries.claim_text: Yemeni government forces said they struck Houthi positions in Mokha on Saturday and carried out three airstrikes in the Taiz region on Sunday.

entries.story_title: Diplomacy over reopening the Strait of Hormuz
entries.claim_text: Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency said the Iran-Oman shipping route agreement will be presented at Monday's Muscat meeting, which Iraq will also attend, but the strait will not reopen unless seven Iranian conditions conveyed to the U.S. are met.

entries.story_title: Diplomacy over reopening the Strait of Hormuz
entries.claim_text: Ebrahim Azizi, head of Iran's parliament national security committee, wrote on X that 'as long as the American side does not accept all of Iran's conditions, dialogue and negotiation are of no use.'

entries.story_title: Diplomacy over reopening the Strait of Hormuz
entries.claim_text: Iran's president Pezeshkian met Egypt's president amid rising regional tensions.

entries.story_title: Diplomacy over reopening the Strait of Hormuz
entries.claim_text: Pezeshkian wrote in a U.S.-aimed social media post: 'Our people can't be bullied into submission. Iran won't surrender.'

entries.story_title: Drone attack shuts Saudi East-West pipeline
entries.claim_text: Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline remained shut on Sunday as a precaution after Thursday's drone attack; the 1,200-km line had been moving 4-5 million barrels per day, about 5% of global supply.

entries.story_title: Drone attack shuts Saudi East-West pipeline
entries.claim_text: Satellite images showed black smoke south of Medina near the East-West pipeline after the drone attack, and some injuries were reported.

entries.story_title: Drone attack shuts Saudi East-West pipeline
entries.claim_text: Iraq dismissed a military commander on Saturday after Baghdad and Riyadh both said the pipeline drone attack had originated in Iraq, where Iranian-backed militias operate.

entries.story_title: Oil price shock (Brent above $100)
entries.claim_text: Brent crude settled Friday at $104.61 a barrel, up 8.7% on the week, after spiking to $107.63 on Thursday; markets were closed Sunday.

entries.story_title: Oil price shock (Brent above $100)
entries.claim_text: Asked about the pipeline closure and moving marine traffic through the strait, President Trump said everything will 'work out fine.'

entries.story_title: Diplomacy over reopening the Strait of Hormuz
entries.claim_text: Iran's President Pezeshkian said Iran and Oman will sign an agreement Monday in Muscat on a joint shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz, in the presence of Arab Gulf foreign ministers, with the IMO then notified.

entries.story_title: Diplomacy over reopening the Strait of Hormuz
entries.claim_text: Bahrain said it will not attend the Muscat meeting or any collective meeting involving Iran until diplomatic relations are restored (ties cut in January 2016).

entries.story_title: Diplomacy over reopening the Strait of Hormuz
entries.claim_text: Pezeshkian said Iran will reopen the Strait of Hormuz when the United States ends its naval blockade and attacks, adding Washington failed militarily and turned to economic pressure.

entries.story_title: Drone attack shuts Saudi East-West pipeline
entries.claim_text: President Trump told reporters in Dublin that Iran was 'probably' behind the Thursday drone attack launched from Iraq that shut Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline (~5 mb/d to the Red Sea).

entries.story_title: Drone attack shuts Saudi East-West pipeline
entries.claim_text: Trump said the Houthis called his administration saying they do not want the U.S. directly involved; the Islamic Resistance in Iraq denied responsibility for the pipeline attack, and Iraq closed some borders as a precaution.

entries.story_title: BRICS New Delhi summit and declaration
entries.claim_text: BRICS leaders unanimously adopted the New Delhi Declaration, expressing deep concern over Middle East escalation and urging maximum restraint through dialogue and diplomacy, without naming any country.

entries.story_title: BRICS New Delhi summit and declaration
entries.claim_text: On the BRICS summit sidelines, Pezeshkian met Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, a notable direct Iran-UAE contact despite opposing sides in the war.

entries.story_title: Houthi west-coast offensive / govt counter-offensive around Mokha
entries.claim_text: Yemeni government forces announced they will deploy weapons and aircraft to retake areas seized in the Houthi lightning offensive, including the road to the port city of Mokha.

entries.story_title: Houthi west-coast offensive / govt counter-offensive around Mokha
entries.claim_text: Satellite and open-source imagery show the Houthis mobilizing on Sept 12, days after capturing Mokha, Perim Island, Dhubab and the Hanish islands.

entries.story_title: Houthi west-coast offensive / govt counter-offensive around Mokha
entries.claim_text: An adviser to Iran's supreme leader called the Houthi west-coast advance a 'clear victory' in a post on X.

entries.story_title: Oil price shock (Brent above $100)
entries.claim_text: The U.S. national average diesel price topped $6 a gallon for the first time ever on Thursday, and the EIA estimated Middle East crude-production shut-ins averaged 6.7 million barrels a day in August.
